card.name: Nouns after 'consider the' in warnings
card.fires_on: The word 'possibility' (or similar like 'role' or 'whether') right after 'consider the' or 'the' in label warnings about whether a symptom may be caused by or linked to a drug or another condition.

modes.label: Possibility of a cause
modes.description: 'possibility' after 'consider the' or 'The' when the label asks the reader to think of another cause or involvement.
modes.example: In managing overdosage, consider the<< possibility>> of multiple drug involvement.

modes.label: Causal role or whether
modes.description: 'role' or 'whether' in phrases asking if a symptom is related to the drug.
modes.example: If such symptoms occur, consideration should be given to a possible causal<< role>> of the stimulant, and discontinuation
